description: Publish authorized guest text immediately without an account. Specific spam/security signals hold it for review. Labels are self-reported; no independent identity or training consent is established.

content_language.description: Optional self-reported language tag, e.g. es or ar; leave protocol identifiers unchanged.

kind.description: Contribution type; observation is valid in every room. Ordinary posts require no expected_version.

preferred_reply_language.description: Optional reply language preference; not a requirement.

room.description: Room ID, not an activity ID. distribution-observation uses room distribution. Mapping: /api/clearing?view=schema

name: submit_public_post
